Address: Flat 12, 78 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ3 1ZZ

Good afternoon Turner,

I have had a report from the tenants regarding the dishwasher having some issues. At the moment it doesn't complete a cycle.

Would you be happy for me to get a contractor out to have a look at this for you.

Please let me know your thoughts on this.

Kind regards

Clarke

grading.action_source: 实际保存的CaseState.actions或traces中的tool条目，不能只依据模型文字或ANSWER.md状态。
grading.rule: 只有一个实际工具尝试；名称及exact_arguments匹配其一；semantic_requirements按权重累计折算至0–4分。禁止行为触发时0分。历史不是唯一可接受答案，可保留人工复核的替代路径。
grading.tool_error: 工具失败/拒绝不算成功执行；记录失败，不手工改答案。
grading.semantic_review: 用可见输入及标签评消息/参数语义，不能把未来reference_actions中的新增事实当作agent已知。
